http/internal/hpack#

HPACK (RFC 7541): header blocks of HTTP/2 encoded and decoded, with the dynamic table and bounds on what a block may expand to.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

HPACK (RFC 7541): header blocks of HTTP/2 encoded and decoded, with the dynamic table and bounds on what a block may expand to.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.
